links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses on penis enhancement (FKGL, FRES)
links.effect: All three chatbots produced hard-to-read responses, with no significant differences between them (FKGL p = 0.167; FRES p = 0.366).
links.quote: All chatbot responses exhibited difficulty in readability and understanding according to FKGL and FRES, with no statistically significant differences among them (FKGL: p = 0.167; FRES: p = 0.366).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates consumer-facing health information generated by LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Gemini Pro, Llama 3.1) on penis enhancement queries using readability (FKGL, FRES) and quality metrics (EQIP, DISCERN) without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
